name: @amodalai/example-underwriting-review
description: The simplest Amodal example: an agent that triages commercial insurance submissions against an underwriting guide. Two triggered tools, a reviewer subagent, no UI. Runs on the Amodal runtime.

amodal.name: underwriting-review-example
amodal.description: Triage commercial property submissions against a fictional underwriting guide. The underwriting-reviewer subagent scores each submission and recommends a workflow status for a human underwriter. The agent assists; a human decides.
